title: Cornered Resource
coreMove: Check whether privileged access to a scarce input independently raises value and cannot be matched by substitutes.
sourcePressure: A cornered resource is preferential access on attractive terms to a coveted resource that independently raises value. The chapter must distinguish true cornering from ordinary strong assets, talent, suppliers, or quality.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A cornered resource is any talented team, useful patent, exclusive supplier, or rare-looking asset.

sourceAnchors.name: patents
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar says examples can involve patents when they provide preferential access to a coveted resource that independently raises value
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A patent is not magic by itself; it matters only when the protected input raises value and rivals cannot get a close substitute.
